newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB shares fall on news of possible rating cut.
newsitem.headline: LTCB shares fall on news of possible rating cut.

text.p: Shares in Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) fell in early Tokyo trading on Tuesday on news of a possible cut in its credit rating.
As of 0048 GMT, LTCB shares were down 12 yen at 375, making it the eighth biggest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Turnover was 384,000 shares.
Standard & Poor's Corp announced after Monday's close that it had placed the long-term and short-term debt and counterparty ratings of LTCB on creditwatch with negative implications.
The move reflected S&P's concerns about LTCB's ability to cope with ongoing deregulation and other changes in Japan's financial markets, S&P said.
